1.t: Al-Qâri‘ah (the striking Hour i.e. the Day of Resurrection).

3.t: And what will make you know what the striking (Hour) is?

4.t: It is a Day whereon mankind will be like moths scattered about.

5.t: And the mountains will be like carded wool.

6.t: Then as for him whose balance (of good deeds) will be heavy,

7.t: He will live a pleasant life (in Paradise).

8.t: But as for him whose balance (of good deeds) will be light,

9.t: He will have his home in Hâwiyah (pit, i.e. Hell).

10.t: And what will make you know what it is?
